Dont know if it help or my case is different.  My diet is pretty much 90% tea, black tea occasionally milk , drink hot. I dont drink water or barely in few months , food i dont eat anything mostly bread occasionally magerine , seldom peanut butter,  and chicken, i just listen to the body en decide what will taste comfortable, as for spices mostly i dont use any or salts, but i like herb spices, when i eat i always have tea to sip along this helps , sometimes i do the body shaker machine or rope skipping, sometimes long walk when i have time, its a slow process that took years but it get better, if bad three days fasting well i drink tea en eat sweets en chocolates so not sure thats fasting but helps. Also minimum it takes me 5 to over a week eating one loaf of bread, i mean eating it as only meal kinda. Energy wise i couldnt say if my diet or burnout i had from many years back but i used to be tired easily, id wake up with energy of 100 men then 4 hours later im running in negative, few months back things just changed i eat like once a day, always energized feel even better when not eating for over a day, even tea i drink about half en less like used to which was 10 plus cups. Also being busy en doing task en sitting less helped, last year i did field work which required me to move a lot en move things around en i dont remember ever being bloated i spend like 7 month and i eat big meals things that i would eat in 5 days twice 3 times a day.

Here a funny matric, i actualy determine my stormuch health by whether my poop smells or not, smell means i ate something stormuch not yet used to  en its uncomfortable,  but keeping on eventually things settle, bloating still there but its more of an itch mostly now.

Hopefully something from my experince could be of help. Also i dont do medication only medication i take sometimes is disprin for flue or medlemon, lol i already throw so much sugar in this body as it is.
